chunks: A Book whose verses have been distinguished and explained, a lucid discourse for people who understand,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Quran's verses are 'distinguished and explained'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Fussilat emphasizes the Quran's clarity (Bayan) as a divine gift specifically tailored for the 'people of knowledge' (Ahl al-'Ilm), who possess the intellectual capacity to derive deep legal and theological insights. The mention of 'Arabic' highlights the linguistic precision that preserves the text's integrity, while the detailed nature of the verses underscores the necessity of Tafsir to uncover the layered meanings intended for the discerning reader.
